title: An Explainable and Scalable Hierarchical Tensor Framework for Integrating Multi-Omics and Digital Pathomics
abstract: arXiv:2611.25584v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Background: Precision oncology requires integration of heterogeneous molecular and pathology data, yet many fusion models offer limited biologically grounded interpretability and struggle with missing modalities.   Methods: We present Hierarchical Interpretable Tensor Fusion (HIT-Fuse), integrating six modalities: somatic copy number variation, DNA methylation, RNA sequencing, microRNA expression, RPPA protein abundance, and vision transformer-derived pathomics across four TCGA cohorts (glioma, lung adenocarcinoma, breast, and kidney cancer). Modality-specific autoencoders compress high-dimensional inputs, followed by two-stage CP tensor decomposition. Missing latent modalities are reconstructed using clinical covariates and observed omics to expand cohorts and retrain downstream models. translated_title: 一种可解释且可扩展的分层张量框架：用于整合多组学与数字病理组学数据
translated_abstract: 背景：精准肿瘤学需要整合异质性的分子与病理数据，然而许多融合模型提供的生物学可解释性有限，且难以应对模态缺失的问题。方法：我们提出分层可解释张量融合框架（HIT-Fuse），整合六种模态：体细胞拷贝数变异、DNA甲基化、RNA测序、microRNA表达、RPPA蛋白丰度以及基于视觉Transformer提取的病理组学特征，涵盖四个TCGA队列（胶质瘤、肺腺癌、乳腺癌和肾癌）。模态特异性自编码器压缩高维输入，随后进行两阶段CP张量分解。缺失的潜在模态通过临床协变量和已观测的组学数据进行重建，以扩充队列规模并重新训练下游模型。数学回溯机制实现全局和局部的可解释人工智能（xAI）归因。结果：HIT-Fuse识别出具有显著（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出HIT-Fuse分层可解释张量融合框架，整合六种多组学与病理组学模态，通过模态特异性自编码器、两阶段CP张量分解、缺失模态重建和数学回溯机制，在精准肿瘤学中实现了可解释且可扩展的多模态数据融合。
en_tdlr: HIT-Fuse is an explainable and scalable hierarchical tensor fusion framework that integrates six multi-omics and pathomics modalities using modality-specific autoencoders, two-stage CP tensor decomposition, missing modality reconstruction, and a mathematical traceback mechanism for global and local xAI attributions in precision oncology.
